description: Clean modular decomposition of complex features with path-scoped role filenames alongside a small flat sibling feature

features/health.ts: export interface HealthStatus { readonly ok: boolean; }
export function checkHealth(): HealthStatus { return { ok: true }; }
features/profile/types.ts: export interface UserProfile { readonly id: string; readonly displayName: string; readonly bio: string; }
features/profile/decisions.ts: export function canPublishProfile(profile: UserProfile): boolean { return profile.displayName.trim().length > 0; }
features/profile/store.ts: export interface ProfileStore { load(id: string): Promise<UserProfile | null>; save(profile: UserProfile): Promise<void>; }
features/profile-chat/types.ts: export interface ChatMessage { readonly id: string; readonly senderId: string; readonly body: string; }
features/profile-chat/decisions.ts: export function isNonEmptyMessage(msg: ChatMessage): boolean { return msg.body.trim().length > 0; }
features/profile-chat/store.ts: export interface ChatStore { append(msg: ChatMessage): Promise<void>; }
